description.from: Ship the module: wheel/sdist, console-script entry point, optional botspy[metrics] extra for example consumers, versioning and changelog via python-semantic-release on main.
description.to: Library crate releases only: release-plz on main for versioning, changelog, tags and GitHub releases; no binary artifacts, no crates.io publish. CI builds and runs the tests (unit + bdd) per target: macOS aarch64 and x86_64, Linux x86_64 and aarch64 (AWS; gnu natively, musl via cross), Windows MSVC. rustfmt + clippy -D warnings.
